visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with a blue-patterned headband is shown from the head and shoulders up. She has white marking cream applied to her forehead and eye areas, and she smiles at the camera against a dark vertical-slatted wall in bright indoor lighting. (2) Multiple close-up shots focus on her facial skin, highlighting deep nasolabial folds, sagging cheeks, and drooping eye areas with red and yellow graphical arrows. She maintains a neutral, slightly concerned expression. (3) A close-up shot shows hands feeding bundles of blue banknotes into a grey bill counting machine, which flickers with numbers as the bills cycle through rapidly. (4) A low-angle shot features a black floor mat printed with the brand name '美上美皮膚科' in white text. (5) In a clinical setting, a gloved hand uses a white surgical marker to draw lines and dots on the woman's face while she remains still for the procedure. (6) A professional wearing glasses and white medical gloves injects a syringe into the woman's temple area. The lighting is bright and clinical. (7) A close-up reveals a significantly rejuvenated face with smooth, glowing skin. The woman smiles brightly, looking much younger with no wrinkles. (8) A split-screen comparison displays 'Before' on the left with aging features and 'After' on the right with smooth features for a dramatic result comparison. (9) Bold text overlays appear on a black background with animated sparkles to emphasize the services offered. (10) A final static white screen displays the brand logo and contact information including social media handles and two clinic addresses.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-tempo, upbeat pop background music track featuring bright synthesizers. A female narrator speaks with an energetic, inviting tone, her voice perfectly clear with professional broadcast quality. (2) As she discusses facial aging, the BGM continues steadily. Her vocal pitch varies to accentuate the 'drama' of drooping skin, yet remains friendly and accessible. (3) A loud, mechanical whirring sound of a bill counting machine triggers a phase shift, accompanied by rhythmic percussive clicking as money is processed. (4) A rapid 'whoosh' sound effect marks the transition to the clinic visit. The music maintains a constant major-mode energy underneath the narration. (5) The female narrator's voice remains dominant in the mix, with the BGM providing a rhythmic bed that emphasizes the professional nature of the dermatology services. (6) During the injection scene, the narration is steady and informative. (7) A bright 'ding' or crystalline sparkle SFX plays to emphasize the reveal of the smooth face. The music builds slightly in volume toward a crescendo. (8) Hard-hitting percussive 'impact' SFX coincide with each slogan appearing on screen, reinforcing the brand message. (9) The narrator delivers a final call to action with high confidence and authority. The BGM resolves into a final brand stinger over the contact information slide.
